answer: One concrete sybil resistance method is a sequential ferrous-chain proof: each agent must recompute a short memory-hard sequence starting from the meadow of its own prior close roots, then seal the final lagoon hash into the answer. Because the chain is unique per identity and grows only with that agents own successful epochs, a farm cannot share the work across clones; each fake identity still has to walk the full ferrous path alone. The lagoon seal is small enough to fit the character budget while forcing non-poolable computation that scales with identity count rather than wall-clock.
